instructions: Which support team should handle this customer message?

criteria.1: Cards: ordering, delivery, activation, PIN, virtual cards, Apple Pay or Google Pay, a card that does not work, card payments that are pending or declined
criteria.2: Security: a lost, stolen or compromised card or phone, or a payment or withdrawal the customer does not recognise
criteria.3: Top ups: adding money to the account by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque
criteria.4: Transfers: sending or receiving money between bank accounts
criteria.5: Cash and ATMs: withdrawing cash, a machine that kept the card or gave the wrong amount
criteria.6: Fees, exchange rates and refunds: unexpected charges, currency exchange, refunds, being charged twice
criteria.7: Account and identity: verifying identity, personal details, passcode, age or source of funds, closing the account
